data: For which model does the SARI score increase the most when increasing the number of training examples?

The question asks for the model where the SARI score increases the most when increasing the number of training examples. From the caption, it is mentioned that the tagging approach clearly outperforms the seq2seq baseline. This implies that the SARI scores for the two tagging approaches (LaserTaggerAR and LaserTaggerFF) will be higher than the seq2seq baseline (seq2seqBERT). 

Looking at the graphs, the green line (seq2seqBERT) shows the lowest SARI scores across all training data sizes. The blue and orange lines (LaserTaggerAR and LaserTaggerFF) show higher SARI scores, but the blue line (LaserTaggerAR) appears to increase more steeply than the orange line (LaserTaggerFF) as the number of training examples increases. Therefore, the model where the SARI score increases the most is LaserTaggerAR.
